verdict.rationale: Raygun documents a Slack integration that posts APM trace messages to a chosen channel, and a PagerDuty integration that opens incidents when an issue is triggered from a rule, so some rule-based routing to Slack and PagerDuty exists. Both are documented only for APM, not tied to crash-reporting alerts. Missing for 10: email alert delivery, routing by project/environment/severity, per-rule thresholds for new issue, frequency spike, or affected-user count, crash-reporting alert rules, and independent corroboration.
